summary: One focused behavior: author the section 60 flag-gated world-state reactions - at least three earlier zones, each altered by one or more reactions from the section 60 category list (new migration, fewer small animals, changed industrial lights, debris shifted, friendly organism near base, radio odd-interference, deep sound audible in shallows), so return trips differ after the authored milestones while the zones are unchanged before them - delivered as trigger entries (flag gate + spawnEntity/despawnEntity/alterAmbient/playAudio effects) plus spawn-table entries in production world data, cheap by construction. AC-enc-reactions is carried verbatim from ST-04, whose four criteria its four children (WI-04a/b/c/d) cover verbatim; WI-04c alone is the final proof owner of AC-enc-reactions. Changed responsibilities are within the cap and concrete: trigger system (reaction trigger entries and the flag-gate enablement), world content data (spawn-table entries, ambient/light/audio/fauna deltas), and headless scenario-test evidence. Verification is focused on this behavior: fresh-save scenarios that reach an authored milestone, physically return to three+ earlier zones, assert the flag-gated changes (spawn-table delta, ambient/light, fauna presence/absence, audio) are present after and absent before the milestone, plus a save round-trip of the flags and a distinct-zone count check; headless is the primary evidence per section 70 and no full browser playthrough is required. Dependencies resolve: WI-04a sets beat completion flags and WI-04d sets puzzle completion flags via setStoryFlag, both consumed here as the section 60 'major milestones'; both are siblings (children of ST-04), not ancestors or descendants, and the storyFlags array is already shared by Simulation into the trigger state and save (src/sim/Simulation.ts), so flags persist across a save round-trip. Boundaries held: no content authorship beyond the reaction data (the radio-interference category is an audio/ambient cue, not a new message in WI-04b's section 38 budget), no balance changes (ST-07) with reaction spawns inside the section 34 ambient caps, and flag-driven/never randomized per section 61. Recorded assumption, consistent with the accepted WI-04b review and ST-04's extend-don't-rebuild boundary: TriggerCondition in src/world/triggers.ts has no story-flag condition today (TriggerContext.storyFlags is populated but read by no condition, and EncounterTrigger.condition is a single condition), so gating reactions on the beat/puzzle completion flags requires adding a minimal storyFlag gate condition - an allowed 'extend, do not rebuild' trigger-system addition, not a new system, matching the section 60 'cheap by construction' claim (evaluated inside the existing per-step trigger loop). For reactions observable only on the return trip (ambient/audio/light applied to an earlier zone, per the spec's 'plus the existing returnThrough condition'), the implementer chooses how to compose the flag gate with returnThrough (a combined or AND-composed condition) within that same trigger-system responsibility; this bounded design decision does not change the one-behavior count or the three named subsystems. The private reveal map (WI-01c) is the source of truth for which zone reacts to which milestone and is referenced by id only, never quoted.
